sections.content: Heyo is a dynamic and innovative full service agency that specializes in creating cutting-edge design and development. We're on a mission to revolutionize user experiences through intuitive and responsive web interfaces. Join our talented team of engineers, and designers to help us build the future of web.

sections.heading: Position Overview
sections.content: We are seeking a skilled Full-Stack Engineer with expertise in React/Next.js and Node.js/Nest.js development to join our team. As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining both the frontend and backend components of our web applications. You will work closely with our product team to deliver high-quality, user-friendly experiences that meet our clients' needs.

sections.heading: Key Responsibilities
sections.content:
Develop responsive web applications using React/Next.js for the frontend and Node.js/Nest.js for the backend.
Collaborate with the design team to translate UI/UX wireframes into interactive and functional web pages.
Implement and maintain reusable components and libraries for efficient development.
Optimize web applications for maximum performance and scalability.
Ensure cross-browser compatibility and responsiveness.
Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services.
Collaborate with other engineers to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies in both frontend and backend development.

sections.heading: Qualifications
sections.content:
Proven experience as a Full-Stack Engineer with a focus on React/Next.js and Node.js/Nest.js.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, ES6+, HTML5, and CSS3.
Familiarity with frontend build tools and package managers (e.g., Vite, npm/yarn/pnpm).
Solid understanding of version control systems (e.g., Git).
Experience with database systems such as PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Passion for testing and confidence in delivery.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
A portfolio of past projects or code samples is a plus.
Familiarity with other frameworks such as Rails, Laravel, or Django is a plus.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience) is a plus.

sections.heading: Heyo offers a variety of benefits, including:
sections.content:
2 weeks paid time off
Flexible schedule (make up your time for important personal, life, family events). We take work / life balance seriously!
4 day client work weeks. We spend Friday's working on internal needs and personal betterment.
You'll get in trouble if we catch you working nights and weekends. For reals.
1 week paid holiday rest at the end of the year. Over 3 weeks of company holidays over the year.
Health insurance coverage.
401k Plan & matching.
Paid parental, adoption/caregiver leave.

sections.heading: How to Apply:
sections.content: If you are passionate about full-stack development, React, TypeScript, and creating exceptional user experiences, we would love to hear from you! Please send your resume, a cover letter, and a link to your portfolio or GitHub profile below.

sections.heading: Everyone is welcome.
sections.content: Heyo is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Heyo is a tight knit team of individuals that love the work we do and more importantly, love the people we get to do it with. If a company who loves doing great work and focuses on people over profits sounds like the type of culture you're looking for, apply now! Join us in shaping the future of web applications.
